content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Accessibility Initiative: Regional Fintech Rollout Planning
agenda_items: Review of current accessibility audit findings for regional platforms
Stakeholder alignment on communication strategy for accessibility updates
Discussion on integration of WCAG 2.2 AA standards into development lifecycle
key_decisions: Form a dedicated cross-functional accessibility task force with representatives from Product, Engineering, and Legal.
Prioritize screen reader compatibility and keyboard navigation enhancements for the next two product cycles.
attendees: Ms. Isabella Rossi, Chief Compliance Officer
Dr. Anya Sharma, VP Strategy & Innovation
Mr. David Chen, Lead UX Strategist

conversation.message: We decided to form a dedicated cross-functional accessibility task force with representatives from Product, Engineering, and Legal, and prioritize screen reader compatibility and keyboard navigation enhancements for the next two product cycles.
